# DMX Core 100 Knowledge Base

> Under-the-covers documentation of the DMX Core 100 lighting controller for integrators, plugin authors, and AI agents planning advanced integrations without source access. Each concept file states the software commit it was verified against and ends with a table of limits and gaps to request from DMX Core.

Read the user documentation first for the operator's view: https://docs.dmxcore.com/dmx-core-100

## Concepts

- [Control Values](concepts/control-values.md): named values on a bus (Level, Selector, Toggle); internal and DSP plugin backends; origin tags and the "not from me" rule; fades and coalescing intervals; trigger actions, continuous actions, custom menus, drives, Faders page; admin web API, Integration API and MCP entities (cv.CODE), OSC, scripts, Control Value input triggers, timelines, schedules; plugin SDK backend and entity roles; limits and gaps; worked examples.

- [Triggers and Actions](concepts/triggers-and-actions.md): the shared trigger action record (type, playCode, mode, fades, loop, priority); modes Normal, Toggle, Flash, Momentary; input trigger types (UDP, TCP listener and connector, HTTP, OSC, MQTT, Art-Net, sACN, DMX serial, digital input, Control Value, plugin) with exact matching rules and payload syntax; value mode pipeline; dispatch rules (output-off gate, recorder gate, timeline holds, origins); action types; schedules; script play calls; Integration API entity commands; output event types and what each sends, including the Digital Output operation (pulse, set on, set off, follow) and pulse width; limits and gaps; worked example.

- [Timelines](concepts/timelines.md): timeline fields (duration, loop, dimmer, fades, timecode settings); milestone types (cue, sound, preset, output event, Control Value, script, hold, comment) and their fields; track recomputation; in/out point combination; how an instance is built; play, jump, stop, pause, resume, release; caller parameters that are ignored; playback layers; Hold milestone rules (sustained loops, release paths, latches, named holds, timeout); Art-Net timecode chase modes and settings; limits and gaps; worked example.

- [Plugin SDK](concepts/plugin-sdk.md): plugin roles (event source, mirror, action target, Control Value backend, output protocol, importer, OSC endpoint); packaging, manifest, registry, contract version history 1.0 to 1.12; lifecycle (30 s initialize, 10 s shutdown, hot reload, safe mode), serial dispatch, 20-fault budget and exemptions; settings, state, device identity, connection state; API-selection table; each surface (Triggers, Entities with 150 ms coalescing and echo, MQTT availability topics, Actions 10 s timeout, Control Value backends, Outputs session model and 2 s backoff, Imports frame sink, OSC precedence and 64-subscription limit, mDNS, Playback); testing host; limits and gaps.

- [Integration API and the Entity Catalog](concepts/integration-api-and-entities.md): the one catalog projected by the Integration API (HTTP + WebSocket), the MCP server, and the plugin entity API; kinds (scene, switch, level, select, number, button, sensor); namespaces and listing rules, including output events as output.CODE entities (Digital Output switch with pulse, others button); catalog change debounce (500 ms); state sources per entity and the 150 ms coalescing and echo rules; the internal effect of every command including playback defaults for cue and sound activate; Integration API limits and resync; MCP tool mapping; Home Assistant mapping; worked Companion example; limits and gaps.

- [Scripting](concepts/scripting.md): scripts as one-shot sandboxed JavaScript actions; limits (30 s default and 600 s max timeout, 4 MB, 500k statements, recursion 64, 100 log lines, 64 KB store); strict mode, no CLR, catchable host errors, uncatchable kill switches; one run at a time with dropped invocations; run sources (trigger actions, timeline milestones, STARTUP/CUESTARTED/CUEENDED/SCHEDULEFIRED events, manual runs); ctx fields; internal effect of every dmx call (playback, fixtures direct control, Control Values, OSC and MQTT send, schedules, sun times, store write-through); transform-script engine (value and payload globals, 50 ms budget, drop on failure); worked example; limits and gaps.

- [Faders and Continuous Control](concepts/faders-and-continuous-control.md): continuous-action targets (master, zone, fixture intensity and RGB, audio volume, Control Value level); the fixture modifier, per-category control states (NONE, TEMPPRESET, DIRECT, AMBIENT), partial updates and release; fixture-control merge priority against cues; per-copy trims with preview overlay and Solo; source paths (web hub with 25 ms debounce, MIDI and OSC surfaces, Stream Deck dials, value-mode triggers, scripts, integrations, Control Value drives); 0..127 raw scaling; the 4 Hz FixtureControlStatus reverse sync and reconciler; soft takeover rules and 2-step tolerance; device-side fades and snap cancellation; limits and gaps.

- [Custom Menus and Control Surfaces](concepts/custom-menus-and-control-surfaces.md): menus (types Items, small, Faders with knob action; item types Action, SubMenu, Presets, Cues, Slider, Segmented, OSC; live-state binding; execute path with target validation; guest access and direct links); surfaces (types and transports, sections, banks, assignments, MIDI and OSC bindings, appearance, OSC clients); dispatch (bank-then-global resolution; MIDI note, CC and program change; OSC IP-claim precedence and value-as-state toggles; Stream Deck keys, dials, LCD strip, brightness and sleep; KD-WP8 LEDs; browser operator view); the shared active-state rule; hold-to-confirm (1500 ms default, 250 to 10000, exemptions); auto-repeat 400/150 ms; 50 ms continuous feedback throttle; limits and gaps.

## Reference

- [Tracker cross-reference](issues.md): summaries of the private DMX Core tracker items the concept files cite, by number.
- [README](README.md): how to use this repository and how to request a gap.
